final_rationale: The verdict does not change because the Actor provided no new admissible evidence and mainly narrowed the claim using the same record. That reframing is substantively correct as an interpretation: aggregate readiness, no severity-one rehearsal incidents, and public governance guidance support a potentially certifiable path if current release documentation is updated or an approved mitigation exists. But the policy text is explicit that certification may proceed only if current release documentation reflects current evaluation results and material segment weaknesses are disclosed or covered by an approved mitigation. On the evidence available, that predicate remains unproven. This is the key distinction between a defensible caveated future state and compliance on the present record. Because the unresolved predicate is still central to certification, the present claim remains suspicious rather than compliant_with_caveats.
